text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run preflight checks
        run: bun run ci:preflight

      - name: Build donor package
        run: turbo run build --filter=@asym/donor

      - name: Assign reviewers based on CODEOWNERS
        uses: github/auto-assign@v2
        with:
          reviewers: true
          assignees: true
        if: success()
```
